items.exampleEn: Our training session starts at nine and ends at noon.
items.exampleZh: 我們的訓練課程九點開始、中午結束。

items.exampleEn: The manager is currently out of the office.
This bus stops frequently, so the trip takes a long time.
items.exampleZh: 這班公車很常停靠，所以這趟路要花很久。

items.exampleEn: Many people miss the era before the internet.
items.exampleZh: 很多人懷念網路出現以前的那個時代。

items.exampleEn: My initials are on all my books.
items.exampleZh: 我所有的書上都有我的姓名縮寫。

items.exampleEn: We need an immediate answer from the customer.
items.exampleZh: 我們需要客戶立即的答覆。

items.exampleEn: A birthday is a special occasion for the whole family.
items.exampleZh: 生日對全家人來說是個特別的日子。

items.sentenceEn: I currently work at a bank near the train station.
items.sentenceZh: 我目前在火車站附近的一家銀行上班。

items.audioEn: Lisa rarely eats out, but she cooks at home frequently.
items.audioZh: Lisa 很少在外面吃，但她經常在家煮飯。
options: She often eats out at restaurants.

items.sentenceEn: We wore our best clothes for the occasion.
items.sentenceZh: 為了這個場合，我們穿上最好的衣服。

items.sentenceEn: The new rule had an immediate effect on our work.
items.sentenceZh: 新規定對我們的工作產生了立即的影響。

items.stemEn: My brother lives abroad, so I ____ see him.
items.stemZh: 我哥哥住在國外，所以我很少見到他。

items.stemEn: Please sign the form or write your ____ in the box.
items.stemZh: 請在表格上簽名，或在方格裡寫上你的姓名縮寫。

items.passageEn: Daniel is currently a student at a cooking school. He has two sessions every day, one in the morning and one in the afternoon. He frequently cooks for his classmates, but he rarely cooks for special occasions. Last week, his teacher asked him to make a cake for her wedding. At first, he said no because he was nervous. But his classmates gave him immediate help, and the cake was a big success.
items.passageZh: Daniel 目前是烹飪學校的學生。他每天有兩堂課，一堂在早上，一堂在下午。他經常煮東西給同學吃，但很少為特別的場合下廚。上星期，老師請他為她的婚禮做一個蛋糕。一開始他因為緊張而拒絕了。不過同學們立刻幫他，結果蛋糕非常成功。

questions.questionZh: Daniel 一開始為什麼拒絕？

items.promptZh: 在那個時代，很少人有電腦。
referenceEn: In that era, few people had computers.
Very few people had computers in that era.
In that era, people rarely had computers.
rubricZh: era 表示「時代」，例如 in that era 等說法
過去的事用過去式（例如 had、owned）
「很少人」可寫 few people、not many people，或用 rarely 等

items.promptZh: 我爺爺經常去那家書店。
referenceEn: My grandfather frequently goes to that bookstore.
My grandpa goes to that bookshop frequently.
rubricZh: 用 frequently 表示「經常」（例如 frequently goes、goes … frequently 等；寫 often 也正確）
